g.text: Show a task once, run it, then watch it catch a save that didn't happen.
Open › New Encounter › Triage › Note › Type "Synthetic follow-up in two weeks" › Save Encounter
Run it on a new note
The record, read back from the database
The app will show its saved message. The database will reject the save.
OpenAdapt reads the record back from the database after each save. It found nothing, so it stopped.
A save may still have gone through, so a person checks the record before anything is retried.
6 of 6 steps · 2 of 2 record checks · 0 model calls
checks the signature in your browser, offline; nothing is uploaded
Give your agent this task as a tool
claude mcp add openadapt -- openadapt agent serve --allow-run
Any other MCP client: openadapt agent serve --allow-run
Done in 23.3s. Reports: openadapt-quickstart, one REPORT.md per run; side by side:
openadapt-quickstart is written unencrypted (synthetic data only); OPENADAPT_FLOW_AT_REST=strict
